text: Standing here, I feel the sharp orderliness of modernity. The room is bright, clean, and almost clinical, with glass walls reflecting an emptiness both literal and existential. The second scene, however, bursts with imagination—the vivid colors and bold R+D signage speak to human curiosity and a drive for innovation. The contrast rejuvenates me. I feel a subtle tension between cool detachment and the electric anticipation of ideas unfolding. I am simultaneously an observer and a participant in the experiment of progress.
